Hyderabad Hosts Defence MSME Manufacturers Forum

Hyderabad is hosting the ICC's Defence MSME Manufacturers Forum, an event focused on the rapid growth of Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in the defence sector within Telangana. The forum aims to foster collaboration and showcase advancements in defence manufacturing. Discussions are expected to cover innovation, investment, and policy support for these enterprises.
